Episode 198. The Bottomless Deal (3)
Drakka, Zipple's main house.

Veradin sat in silence for a long time, looking at the executives seated around him. Apart from Ronil, Octavia, and the pure-blooded Zipples that Veradin had brought, all of the executives were filled with fear.
This was because the corridor outside the conference room was littered with corpses.
After the incident at the Tower of Talk, naturally, an uneasy atmosphere had engulfed the entire Zipple family. There were only rumors circulating without any official announcements.

During this, Veradin convened the family meeting for the first time. Just before the start of this meeting, which was composed solely of pure-blooded Zipples and elders, Veradin carried out a short but intense purge.
Those who had doubts about the incident at the Tower of Talk were annihilated in an instant. The deceased could not even resist properly against the sudden attack.
However, even if they could have resisted, the result would have been the same. Veradin's power was absolute in the sanctuary and at the Drakka headquarters.
"There was a slight delay. It was a decision made to lead the family efficiently as the new family head, so I'd appreciate your understanding, even if it was unpleasant to watch."
The executives looked at each other. Killing more than thirty executives in an instant and sitting down was called a slight delay.
Moreover, Veradin was calling himself the family head. The life and death of Kellic did not matter anymore due to his expression.
Whether he was alive or dead, the fact that Veradin had usurped the position of the family head did not change.

"You must have many questions. What happened to the former head and Cadun, how our Zipple will be operated from now on. These matters will be sorted out gradually with the help of my sister, Satrin Zipple, who has been newly appointed as the judge. We plan to announce it publicly soon."
Satrin Zipple nodded slightly as she looked at the executives.

Not only her, but all the pure-bloods that Veradin brought were appointed to the highest positions. From the perspective of the existing executives, it was a tyranny following a rebellion, but no one could resist.
Veradin felt disillusionment at their demeanor.
Of course, if they rebelled, he would thoroughly kill and trample on them, but it occurred to him that this very behavior revealed the fragile state of Zipple.
It was due to the long reign as the world's leading family.
It was time to reclaim the initial belief of the family that one is not strong because of the name Zipple, but they should be Zipple because they are strong. This needed to be done from the roots.
"So, let's not talk about that for now, let's talk about recent matters. Our enemies have started to make strange moves while we were organizing our family."
"…Understood."
"Firstly, Kinzelo unilaterally stopped our steel trade recently. Of course, the Barmel Alliance, Jin Lun Candle, is behind this."
"It's strange, Lord. Kinzelo is also in a situation where they need to check the Barmel Alliance, so there's no reason to suddenly give them steel. It's not that we were buying it cheap."
As one executive opened his mouth, Veradin nodded. If there were those who couldn't accept the change, there were also those who adapted quickly.

"In addition, according to our spies, it's said that the land of Shuin, the most important branch of Kinzelo, has collapsed. Maybe the Barmel Alliance attacked Kinzelo in retaliation for the steel trade, and Kinzelo, who couldn't withstand the pressure, might have given up the steel."

"That's an interesting story. However, Kinzelo is not the type to bow down to just that. If the Barmel Alliance attacked, there's a higher chance that a full-scale war would have started immediately."
"Then, if the Lord says that Jin Lun Candle is behind it……"
"I think there was some sort of deal between Jin and Kinzelo. And that deal is probably related to the branch destruction that Elder Ritan just mentioned."
"A deal... You mean, Kinzelo requested support from Jin Lun Candle?"
"In my view, yes. One power, excluding us, Barmel Alliance, Lun Candle and the Empire, attacked Kinzelo, and Kinzelo requested support from Jin."
"But, except for those powers, isn't there a group powerful enough to attack Kinzelo? Bement Huang's family has some power, but they don't seem to be throwing this kind of desperate measure."
The remnants of the Bement royal family had cut off contact with Zipple and disappeared after the Hyungshinjeon.
"It won't be the remnants of the royal family. I think, a new power has appeared."
"A new power......!?"
"If it's a new power, it must be a case where neutrals have joined forces... But, excluding the heads of the current major powers, isn't there anyone who can gather the neutrals?"

"There may not be a person, but if Joshua Lun Candle, whose life and death have not been confirmed since the Hyungshinjeon, appears, it's not impossible. However, if it was Joshua, Lun Candle wouldn't be silent."
Various words were exchanged among the executives for a while. Veradin watched them and shared information he recently learned.
"It's not Joshua Lun Candle. If he started activities using the power of chaos, I could know it with my power. So, I think it's the work of the underground world."
"The underground world……?"
"A document that no one but the Lord can read, one of them had information about the underground world."
Originally, that reading room could not be accessed without Shinu's permission, but Veradin had broken the seal using Sanna's power.

"What we call the demonic world is located underground in this world. And at the boundary separating the surface and the underground, a creature known as the Great Serpent and some ancient races are sealed."
The officers, except for his closest aides, didn't know how to react to the sudden news. They even wondered if Veradin had gone mad.

However, the next moment, Veradin took out a scroll from his belongings and unfolded it in front of the officers. The scroll contained a depiction of the content he spoke about, a representation of the boundary between the surface and the underground, and Ameris. At the bottom, the seal of fire flickered.
What that seal signified was absolute trust. The officers didn't doubt any longer and paid full attention to Veradin's words.

"That's why I concluded that the ones who attacked Kinzelo this time were either demons or some other ancient races. But since most of the demons that have appeared so far are affiliated with Kinzelo, it seems more likely to be an ancient race."
"So, according to the Head, an ancient race from the underground has been released from the seal for some reason... and attacked Kinzelo. And Kinzelo has asked Barmel Union for help."

"That's correct. Therefore, our task is to find out about them. Who are they that attacked Kinzelo, why was Kinzelo their first target on the surface, why did Kinzelo ask for support from Jin instead of us, what are Orgal and Zephyrin doing?"
As Veradin summarized, the officers nodded.

"Instruct your subordinates to issue orders immediately. Have them draft an article as if everything discussed today is true. And the Phantom Commander should send Phantom Troops and the magicians of the judges to the Kinzelo branches in collaboration with the judges."
"Understood."

"Right now, we inevitably lag behind the Barmel Union and Kinzelo in terms of information. We must narrow the gap by any means, and find an effective way to deal with the underground forces. Those who produce results will be given the opportunity to learn the family's Vision Magic."
Vision Magic, like Lunandel's decisive technique, wasn't something anyone could learn. Only those with magical affinity equal to a pure-blooded Jipel could learn it.
"It requires a tremendous amount of wealth, but the research department has developed a technology that can stably increase magical affinity. Please work hard."
The first day of April, 1803.
Jin was sitting in a makeshift camp set up on the outskirts of Kinzelo's third base, sipping his tea.
"Have you arrived?"
Jin asked, seeing Bishukel enter the tent. Since the deal was settled, he had been staying up for several days inspecting the branches of Kinzelo.
Jin hadn't helped with that. The Barmel Union was merely on standby. Jin and Ciris were waiting at two suspected attack points.
"...It seems they haven't shown up here yet."
"That's right. It would have been great if either Nana or Lord Ciris was at the 7th branch during the last attack, but unfortunately, it didn't happen."

Two days ago, while Jin and Ciris were each waiting at the 3rd and 5th branches, the enemy tribe attacked Kinzelo's 7th branch. The result was a massacre, there were no signs of resistance to be found on the bodies of the beastmen at the 7th branch.
Despite the risky deal with Jin, Kinzelo lost another branch, which must have driven them mad. Moreover, Orgal and Zephyrin were still unconscious.
'Zephyrin could have been one of the heads of Ameris...'

Jin shrugged his shoulders, recalling what Ameris had said. Ameris said if Zephyrin really lost consciousness because of him, that must be the only reason. The fact that Orgal fainted was probably because he was mentally connected to Zephyrin.
"While I was touring the branches, I checked some news. I saw an article that Veradin Jipel has become the new head of the Jipel family."
"...Veradin?"

"Yes. Moreover... look at this. The first thing Veradin did when he became head was to disclose about the underworld and express doubts about the relationship between Kinzelo and Barmel Union. This just came out in the news."
Jin's eyes widened.
"An announcement that Veradin became the new head is shocking enough, but suddenly doubts about the underworld and our deal?"
"Because of this, various words are going around among the demons in Kinzelo now. There's no guess at all......"
"Hold on."
Jin's eyes sharpened as he was about to review the newsletter.
"It's them, they've timed it well. Bishukel."
Then he stood up from his seat and stretched lightly.
"...The enemy tribe?"

Bishukel belatedly sharpened his senses, but he couldn't feel any particular energy. His skills were significantly inferior to Jin's, and he didn't have a wide heart. What Jin read was the explosive brain energy unique to a wide heart, which suddenly spread near the 3rd branch.
"That's right. It looks like we'll have to check the newsletter after dealing with them. I'll go ahead, follow me."
